title: Liu Zong, Wen Ling and the Dark Abyss
summary: Liu Zong, second head of Liu Realm and a Spirit-level fighter, corners Mu Chen for the copper piece until Zhou Ye arrives, alerted by a letter Mu Chen sent through Tan Qingshan. At home Mu Chen, at the middle phase of Spiritual Movement, shows Mu Feng the piece; Mu Feng recognises the Jiuyou Bird, 11th on the earth list of beasts, and the piece reveals that it failed an evolution and fell somewhere. Liu Qingtian orders his men into the Dark Abyss to take the bird. Mu Feng agrees to take Mu Chen only if he reaches late-phase Spiritual Movement before they leave, and tells him the Great Buddha Art resonates with his mother's bloodline. At Mu Realm's Spirit Collecting Formation Square, the Level 1 spiritual formation master Wen Ling watches Mu Chen form five spiritual seals on his first try and gives him two formation maps. Mu Chen reaches late-phase Spiritual Movement, and the Mu party enters the Dark Abyss, where Liu Qingtian is waiting.
events: Zhou Ye saves Mu Chen from Liu Zong
Mu Feng identifies the copper piece's totem as the Jiuyou Bird
Liu Qingtian orders an expedition to the Dark Abyss
Mu Feng sets Mu Chen the late-phase Spiritual Movement condition
Wen Ling teaches spiritual seals; Mu Chen forms five at once
Mu Chen reaches late-phase Spiritual Movement
Mu Realm enters the Dark Abyss and meets Liu Qingtian
cultivation: Mu Chen is at the middle phase of Spiritual Movement early in the episode and reaches the late phase before the expedition. Liu Zong is at Spirit (subs: Divine Soul Level). Wen Ling is a Level 1 spiritual formation master; Mu Chen forms five spiritual seals on his first attempt.
